difficulty_reason: Prove H_i(f) is an isomorphism for f : L -> K of simplicial presheaves with L_i = K_i for i < n, L_n -> K_n sheaf-surjective, and L, K cosk_n-sk_n-isomorphic: let K'_n be the image of L_n -> K_n and form the n-truncated U with U_i = K_i (i < n), U_n = K'_n, then K' = cosk_n U; because K'_m is a finite limit and sheafification is exact, (K'_m)^# = K_m, so (K')^# = K^# and H_i(K) = H_i(K'), reducing the lemma to the case where L_n -> K_n is surjective on presheaves; in that case L(U) -> K(U) is a trivial Kan fibration for every U (simplicial-lemma-section), hence a homotopy equivalence, and applying free abelian groups gives the result.
